crm_notes:
Summary: Conductor AI builds an inline PR assistant for engineering orgs — goal is reduce PR review time and noise. Team is swayed by low-latency streaming + tight model-version pinning. Key asks: sub-200ms per-turn streaming in IDE (VSCode), determinism for comment templates, reranking of candidate comments to minimize false positives.

Notes from 2/25 demo: SE demoed a VSCode flow where the assistant streams a 3-line diff summary in ~120ms after snapshot and then offers 5 inline comment suggestions. Engineering lead: "We need predictable latency for autocomplete in review flow — bursts on large monorepo PRs are critical." Wants autoscaling headroom and dedicated capacity for predictable p50/p95.

Security: Must satisfy SSO (Okta), audit logs for every generated comment, KMS-managed keys for any cached KV prefixes, and optional regional residency for EU-only projects. Legal flagged retention policy (30/90/365) choices.

POC metrics requested: median latency for initial summary, tokens-per-comment cost, comment precision @ top-3, reranking lift vs. baseline. Marcus to run AB test with and without Redwood Optimize suggestions.

Integration asks: GitHub App + webhook handler, optional self-hosted webhook relay in VPC, IDE plugin scaffolding (VSCode + JetBrains).
